card.name: Digits inside percentages in trial tables
card.fires_on: Digits and decimal points partway through a number in adverse-event or trial result tables, usually within a percentage or n/N count in parentheses. It responds on the point or the first digit before the final digits.

modes.label: Decimal point in a percentage
modes.description: The period between digits of a percentage in a results table.

modes.label: Digit inside a count or percent
modes.description: A digit within a fraction or percent in parentheses after a patient count.

card.plain: It fires in the middle of numbers like percentages and patient counts in clinical trial tables.
